name: Configuration Troubleshooting
description: Trace a bad setting to the file and key that the process actually loaded.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Find files by name in an unfamiliar tree.
Read logs for a process this run already started.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
Run a command on a configured server alias.

validation.rule: The loaded config path and the offending key were cited from a file read or a log line.
